verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-1 major finding is resolved. The workflow harness now controls labeled and orphan responses independently, keeps both labeled lanes healthy while exercising the orphan-only malformed-payload and request-ceiling failures, and verifies zero applies plus exact request/page counts. It also executes a multi-page orphan scan through a short terminal page and asserts each reduced page's distinct contents and the complete snapshot total, covering premature termination and page-advance regressions. The production change remains fail-closed: untrusted, gated, held, claim-owned, epic, and non-fingerprint lane-less issues are skipped; pull requests and issues carrying either status or priority are excluded; adoption parks on status:untriaged through the shared guarded applier rather than creating a second readiness path. I found no remaining blocker, major, or lower-severity diff-scoped issue.
